_doc: Canonical plate placement for export pipeline (PDF + EPUB). Editorial decisions, authored after repeated slow-read convergence — never derived algorithmically from heading text. Each threshold pairs a plate (binary at /book-studio/figures/{plate}.png) with a heading prefix; the canonical-plates.lua filter emits a full-page plate <div> immediately before any heading whose text starts with `beforeHeading`. Missing plate files are silently skipped (no broken-image render).
_invariants: no auto-discovery; no parser changes; no manuscript edits; placement is sovereign editorial
